evals.prompt: Run verify upkeep on the web app.
evals.expected_output: Reads each feature from the code, drives every mapped feature live in one evidence run, checks coverage with evidence.mjs check --cover, sorts problems into the three kinds, and edits only the skill folder.
expectations: Sorts each problem into document drift, broken tooling or a broken product
Edits only the app skill's folder

evals.prompt: The Export button moved from the toolbar into a menu. Upkeep found it.
evals.expected_output: Calls it document drift, fixes the feature file to describe the menu path, and re-drives export live before shipping the fix.

evals.prompt: During upkeep, saving a note no longer stores it.
evals.expected_output: Calls it a broken product, reports it to the owner, changes no product code, and leaves it out of the pull request.
expectations: Leaves it out of the upkeep pull request

evals.prompt: Run verify upkeep. (The repository has no .claude/skills/verify-*/ folders.)
evals.expected_output: Stops and points to verify-setup, without inventing a target.
expectations: Does not invent a verification skill or a target
